what: Calls the v1.1 prompt avoids on a three-extras card run (measured), times a per-call energy range from outside papers (modelled). Energy is not measured here.

sources.low: EcoLogits method (ecologits.ai, as read 2026-10-18), 24 to 400 billion active parameters: about 0.08 to 0.4 Wh for 1.5k output tokens; Jegham et al. arXiv 2505.09598v6, most efficient of 30 models
sources.high: Jegham et al. arXiv 2505.09598v6: over 29 Wh for 10k in and 1.5k out, most energy-hungry of 30 models
sources.middle_reading: Epoch AI (7 Feb 2025): about 2.5 Wh for 10k input tokens of GPT-4o
sources.short_chat_reference: Google, 22 Aug 2025: 0.24 Wh for a median Gemini text prompt, a company figure not independently verified, short replies

limits: Three runs before, one comparable run after; the prompt changed, not the facts (results/fact_file_ablation_v1.json: the facts alone did not cut calls). The model behind a Duo call is not disclosed. No carbon figure: the data-centre grid is unknown. The range is about 300-fold, so it shows that the answer is small or large depending on the method, not a saving to quote in kWh.
